officialScope.finding: Trandumskogen is a national war memorial. The protected scope includes a defined forest area, the tank shooting range and the ceremonial memorial area. The page documents 194 executed people, the 1954 monument, the 1970 memorial plaque and the 2020 protection decision.

municipalIdentity.finding: Ullensaker describes the memorial grove, marked former graves, access to the memorial area and the relationship between the execution site and the shooting range.

namedPoint.finding: The named Trandumskogen point has exactly the same coordinate as the legacy marker. Wikidata links the named site to OSM node 8745441267.

componentCrossCheck.name: Stridsvognskytebanen i Trandumskogen
componentCrossCheck.finding: The separately named tank shooting range lies inside the existing 300-metre gameplay radius and matches the component described by Riksantikvaren. Raw way geometry is not used to derive the canonical marker.

visualCrossCheck.finding: A historic grave-area photograph viewpoint is close to the named point. It is used only as visual QA, never as a coordinate source.

decision.representationLimit: The marker represents the named memorial destination and its ceremonial/grave-area core. The 300-metre circle covers the nearby shooting-range component for gameplay but is not a legal protection polygon.
